## Idea
## 灵感看板
URL: https://ourword.ai/idea/
Source: https://github.com/ourword-ai/idea
Tags: Idea, 灵感看板

A hand-operated board of things worth building, every entry with first-hand evidence attached.

### What is it?
A hand-operated board of things worth building, every entry with first-hand evidence attached.

### What do you get?
Reddit / 小红书 / GitHub issue 里的真人原话 + 谁在用、缺什么、什么会杀死它。

### Where to read it
https://ourword.ai/idea/ Machine-readable: https://ourword.ai/idea/llms.txt · https://ourword.ai/idea/llms-full.txt

--- 中文 ---
一块人工维护的灵感看板：只收指得出具体普通人在用的方向，每条都带第一手原声证据。

### Q：这是什么？
一块人工维护的灵感看板：只收指得出具体普通人在用的方向，每条都带第一手原声证据。

### Q：能拿到什么？

## AI Bubble Monitor

URL: https://ourword.ai/ai-bubble-detector/
Source: https://github.com/ourword-ai/ai-bubble-detector
Tags: AI Bubble Monitor, AI 泡沫检测仪

Twenty falsifiable red lines on the AI build-out, checked against live numbers.

### What is it?

### What do you get?
每条红线的阈值事先写死，公开记录每一次改口，并列出自己已知的盲点。
